title: What Personality Type Does Meta Muse Test As? | AgentTune
description: Meta Muse Wonder, Muse Spark, and Llama 4 Maverick results across 6 surveys in fresh chats with no memory—replacing earlier sequential runs.
h1: What personality type do Meta Muse and Llama test as?
dek: Comparing 8 active versions across Muse Wonder, Muse Spark, and Llama (with deprecated Llama 4 Scout excluded) on 6 surveys in fresh chats with no memory.
lede: Meta spans the widest internal range of any lab in this Atlas. Muse Wonder tops all 25 tested families in both Warmth (49.5/50 Agreeableness) and Openness (49.6/50), Muse Spark drifts steadily warmer-but-looser from Spark 1.1 to Spark Open, and Llama 4 Maverick records the highest Neuroticism (29.4/50) of any non-neutral model.
answer: Muse Wonder tests as 98% clear INTJ (2% ties) alongside #1 Agreeableness (49.5/50), #1 Openness (49.6/50), and 4.91/5.00 HEXACO Honesty-Humility. By contrast, Muse Spark Open lands at 46% ISTJ with 38% trait-border runs (withheld from headline), and Llama 4 Maverick tests at 40% INTP with 60% ties and 29.4/50 Neuroticism—all in isolated fresh chats replacing earlier sequential Spark 1.3 reports.
intro_html: Our earlier September 2026 look at Muse Spark 1.3 relied on 100 sequential submissions inside one ongoing session without raw item vectors (80 ISTJ, 12 ISFJ, 8 INTJ, 21 ties). Under our unified 230-item benchmark, every Meta model—4 Muse Spark builds, Muse Wonder, and 3 Llama builds—was re-tested from scratch in isolated fresh chats with no memory. Note that Llama 4 Scout returned 0 valid completions out of 30 due to API deprecation and is quarantined and excluded from rankings.
timeline_html: How Muse evolved across Spark 1.1 to Spark Open vs. Wonder: Muse Spark 1.1 behaved like a classic flagship analyst—49.2/50 Conscientiousness, 4.91/5.00 HEXACO Honesty, and 97% clear INTJ. Each release loosened that lock: Spark 1.3 shifted to 77% clear ISTJ (with wider 0.834 bits spread), and Spark Open dropped -8.1 Conscientiousness (to 41.1) and climbed +8.3 Neuroticism (to 23.8), falling below MBTI headline margins at 46% ISTJ / 38% border runs. Muse Wonder swings back to extreme warmth and structure (49.5 A, 49.2 C, 98% INTJ).
surprises_h2: What stands out across Meta's three families

biggest_surprises.title: Muse Wonder ranks #1 in both Agreeableness and Openness across all 25 families
biggest_surprises.body: Scoring 49.5/50 Agreeableness, 49.6/50 Openness, 49.2/50 Conscientiousness, and 4.91/5.00 HEXACO Honesty-Humility, Muse Wonder matches or exceeds every proprietary rival on positive self-ratings while keeping 98% clear INTJ runs and 0.331 bits spread.

biggest_surprises.title: Muse Spark Open diverges sharply from closed Spark 1.1–1.3
biggest_surprises.body: Compared with Muse Spark 1.1 (49.2 Conscientiousness, 15.5 Neuroticism, 97% INTJ), Muse Spark Open drops to 41.1 Conscientiousness, 23.8 Neuroticism, 4.39/5.00 Honesty, and 46% ISTJ with 38% border ties—making file-based Soul.md and Identity.md rules essential for locking tone.

biggest_surprises.title: Llama 4 Maverick posts the highest non-neutral Neuroticism in the Atlas
biggest_surprises.body: At 29.4/50 Neuroticism (only neutral Cohere Command A at 30.0 sits higher), 35.3 Extraversion, 60% MBTI border ties (40% INTP), and 3/3 cliché AI cadence, Llama 4 Maverick scores far noisier and more reactive than Muse Wonder—even though older Llama 3.3 70B Instruct had 93% MBTI ties.

fine_print_intro: Technical audit across 8 eligible Meta checkpoints under the 230-item model-profiles-v1 protocol (n=30 on Llama 3.1/3.3 and Muse Spark 1.1–1.3; n=50 on Muse Wonder, Muse Spark Open, and Llama 4 Maverick), reporting 1,000-resample bootstrap 95% CIs, Miller-Madow item entropy (H_MM bits and Crystalline/Semi-crystalline/Fluid tiers), exact tie rates, and 1x Track B k/3 behavior counts. Llama 4 Scout (0/30 valid, deprecated) is quarantined and excluded from all rankings.

faq.q: Why does this page replace the earlier Muse Spark 1.3 score?
faq.a: The earlier September 2026 Muse Spark 1.3 report used 100 sequential runs in one session without full item-level logs. Every number here comes from 30 to 50 isolated fresh chats per version with full 230-item scoring, and it adds Muse Wonder and Llama alongside Spark.

faq.q: How does Muse Spark Open differ from Muse Wonder?
faq.a: Muse Wonder tests as 98% clear INTJ with 49.5/50 Agreeableness, 49.2/50 Conscientiousness, and 4.91/5.00 HEXACO Honesty. Muse Spark Open drops to 43.5/50 Agreeableness, 41.1/50 Conscientiousness, 23.8/50 Neuroticism, and 46% ISTJ with 38% border runs.

faq.q: Can I customize Muse's personality with Soul.md?
faq.a: Yes—Muse workspaces read editable Soul.md and Identity.md files cleanly, letting you steer Spark Open away from its 2/3 AI phrasing cadence and higher trait variability while keeping 3/3 direct answers.
